defs.def: to make sb sad and without enthusiasm or hope 使抑郁；使沮丧；使消沉；使失去信心

ex.s: He made people laugh at a time when they felt depressed, so they could forget their difficulties.
ex.t: 在人们感到沮丧的时候，他让他们发笑，这样他们就能忘记困难。

ex.s: Other students are not mature enough to handle the challenges by themselves and may become depressed.
ex.t: 其他学生还不够成熟，无法独自应对挑战，可能会变得抑郁。

ex.s: It was affecting my schoolwork and my health, and I felt quite depressed.
ex.t: 它影响了我的学业和健康，我感到相当沮丧。

ex.s: I had a teenage patient, who was depressed and moody.
ex.t: 我曾有一个青少年患者，他很抑郁，情绪多变。

ex.s: At first, Reeve's 6 made him very depressed but eventually, he decided to recover as best he could.
ex.t: 起初，里夫的遭遇让他非常沮丧，但最终他决定尽力康复。

defs.def: to make trade, business, etc. less active 使萧条；使不景气
to make the value of prices or wages lower 降低（价格）；减少（工资）
to press or push sth down, especially part of a machine 按，压，推下（尤指机器部件）
